author: alqst
quote: The graphics and map are insane, nobody is denying that. But once the honeymoon phase wears off, this doesn't feel like a GTA game **** story is way too focused on Lucia and their relationship drama. Instead of playing a ruthless criminal taking over Vice City and pulling off crazy heists, half the time you're sitting through heavy arguments and soap-opera tension. The actual crime takes a backseat, and it takes itself way too seriously—watching a dramatic relationship cutscene right before running people over in a neon supercar just feels weird. Without the sharp, cynical humor of the old games, it feels like an interactive drama wearing a GTA skin.
